No actual CDP seam RED→GREEN or fresh physical browser verification was run for this change; the builder report correctly acknowledges this. The prior Chrome fixture belongs to earlier source and does not close this gap.

The tests do not exercise replacement between the second foreground sample and clickPickerDone's new session, so the cross-session identity gap is invisible (data-guest-picker-driver.test.mjs:117-120,155-197).

No executed return-expected gut check or targeted mutation proof was supplied for the added test, as forcing-function-tests requires. This matters because the constant box response lets a stale-coordinate implementation stay green.
